name: Vop
summary: Vọp, also written dọp, is a large shellfish eaten with mỡ hành and peanuts, or grilled. It is not too chewy.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town streets.
howToEat: Grilled, or with scallion oil and peanuts, at the table with the seafood lunch.
Dân Việt says 100,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking.
where: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, xã Cần Giờ.
seoTitle: Vop — a Can Gio shellfish with scallion oil
seoDescription: Vọp is a large shellfish with scallion oil and peanuts, or grilled, and not too chewy.
texture: The diner calls it large and not too chewy.
